title: canarium merrillii var. originarium
intro: Canarium merrillii var. originarium, commonly known as the Philippine canarium or canarium tree, is a species of plant in the family Burseraceae. This plant is a tree known for its medicinal properties and is native to the Philippines. The health benefits of Canarium merrillii var. originarium include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
